license_required.quote: Practicing dentistry or dental hygiene unless the person has an appropriate, active license issued by the department pursuant to this chapter

age_minimum.quote: Is 18 years of age or older

degree_required.value: D.D.S. or D.M.D. from accredited dental school
degree_required.quote: Is a graduate of a dental school accredited by the American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation or its successor entity, if any, or any other dental accrediting entity recognized by the United States Department of Education

accrediting_body.value: American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation
accrediting_body.quote: American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation or its successor entity

exams.name: Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations (JCNDE)
exams.quote: Has successfully completed the examination administered by the Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations or its successor organization

exams.name: American Dental Licensing Examination (ADLE)
exams.quote: A practical or clinical examination, which must be the American Dental Licensing Examination produced by the American Board of Dental Examiners, Inc., or its successor entity

exams.name: Florida Laws and Rules Examination
exams.quote: A written examination on the laws and rules of the state regulating the practice of dentistry

renewal_fee_usd.quote: the fee set by the board not to exceed $300

required.quote: each licensed dentist shall be required to complete biennially not less than 30 hours of continuing professional education in dental subjects, with a minimum of 2 hours of continuing education on the safe and effective prescribing of controlled substances

hours_per_period.quote: not less than 30 hours of continuing professional education in dental subjects

value: 2 hours on safe and effective prescribing of controlled substances
topical_requirements.quote: with a minimum of 2 hours of continuing education on the safe and effective prescribing of controlled substances

national_association.quote: American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation

regulatory_model.quote: Practicing dentistry or dental hygiene unless the person has an appropriate, active license issued by the department pursuant to this chapter

credential_type.quote: The department shall license an applicant who the board certifies meets all of the following criteria

is_mandatory.quote: Practicing dentistry or dental hygiene unless the person has an appropriate, active license issued by the department pursuant to this chapter

title_protection.quote: Using the name or title "dentist," the letters "D.D.S." or "D.M.D.", or any other words, letters, title, or descriptive matter which in any way represents a person as being able to diagnose, treat, prescribe, or operate for any disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury, or physical condition of the teeth or jaws or oral-maxillofacial region unless the person has an active dentist's license

scope_protection.quote: Practicing dentistry or dental hygiene unless the person has an appropriate, active license issued by the department pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to obtain, obtaining, or renewing a license by bribery, fraudulent misrepresentation, or through an error of the department or board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to obtain, obtaining, or renewing a license under this chapter by bribery, fraudulent misrepresentations, or through an error of the department or the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license to practice dentistry revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against in another state, territory, or country
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license to practice dentistry or dental hygiene revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against, including the denial of licensure, by the licensing authority of another state, territory, or country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted or found guilty of or entering a plea of nolo contendere to a crime relating to the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a crime in any jurisdiction which relates to the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising goods or services in a manner which is fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising goods or services in a manner which is fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading in form or content contrary to s. 466.019 or rules of the board adopted pursuant thereto

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising, practicing, or attempting to practice under a name other than one's own
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising, practicing, or attempting to practice under a name other than one's own

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the department any person who is clearly in violation of the chapter or rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the department any person who the licensee knows, or has reason to believe, is clearly in violation of this chapter or of the rules of the department or the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising any unlicensed person to practice dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding, assisting, procuring, or advising any unlicensed person to practice dentistry or dental hygiene contrary to this chapter or to a rule of the department or the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being employed by any corporation, organization, group, or person other than a dentist or professional corporation composed of dentists
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being employed by any corporation, organization, group, or person other than a dentist or a professional corporation or limited liability company composed of dentists to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to perform any statutory or legal obligation placed upon a licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to perform any statutory or legal obligation placed upon a licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a report which the licensee knows to be false or failing to file a required report
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report which the licensee knows to be false, failing to file a report or record required by state or federal law, knowingly impeding or obstructing such filing or inducing another person to do so

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing any act which would constitute sexual battery upon a patient or intentionally touching the sexual organ of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing any act which would constitute sexual battery, as defined in chapter 794, upon a patient or intentionally touching the sexual organ of a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in or related to the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making deceptive, untrue, or fraudulent representations in or related to the practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to keep written dental records and medical history records justifying the course of treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to keep written dental records and medical history records justifying the course of treatment of the patient including, but not limited to, patient histories, examination results, test results, and X rays, if taken

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to make available to a patient or client copies of documents relating to the patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to make available to a patient or client, or to her or his legal representative or to the department if authorized in writing by the patient, copies of documents in the possession or under control of the licensee which relate to the patient or client

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing professional services which have not been duly authorized by the patient or client
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing professional services which have not been duly authorized by the patient or client, or her or his legal representative, except as provided in ss. 766.103 and 768.13

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, procuring, dispensing, administering, mixing, or otherwise preparing a legend drug in excessive or inappropriate quantities
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, procuring, dispensing, administering, mixing, or otherwise preparing a legend drug, including any controlled substance, other than in the course of the professional practice of the dentist. For the purposes of this paragraph, it shall be legally presumed that prescribing, procuring, dispensing, administering, mixing, or otherwise preparing legend drugs, including all controlled substances, in excessive or inappropriate quantities is not in the best interest of the patient and is not in the course of the professional practice of the dentist

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, procuring, dispensing, or administering any medicinal drug from a controlled substance schedule to oneself
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, procuring, dispensing, or administering any medicinal drug appearing on any schedule set forth in chapter 893, by a dentist to herself or himself, except those prescribed, dispensed, or administered to the dentist by another practitioner authorized to prescribe them

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness or use of alcohol, drugs, or other material
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to practice her or his profession with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness or use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material or as a result of any mental or physical condition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing fraud, deceit, or misconduct in the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing fraud, deceit, or misconduct in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide and maintain reasonable sanitary facilities and conditions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide and maintain reasonable sanitary facilities and conditions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide adequate radiation safeguards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide adequate radiation safeguards

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing any procedure or prescribing any therapy which constitutes experimentation without first obtaining full, informed, and written consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any procedure or prescribing any therapy which, by the prevailing standards of dental practice in the community, would constitute experimentation on human subjects, without first obtaining full, informed, and written consent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being guilty of incompetence or negligence by failing to meet minimum standards of performance in diagnosis and treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being guilty of incompetence or negligence by failing to meet the minimum standards of performance in diagnosis and treatment when measured against generally prevailing peer performance, including, but not limited to, the undertaking of diagnosis and treatment for which the dentist is not qualified by training or experience or being guilty of dental malpractice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or accepting and performing professional responsibilities which the licensee knows or has reason to know that she or he is not competent to perform

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person who is not qualified by training, experience, or licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person who is not qualified by training, experience, or licensure to perform them

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a lawful order of the board or department or failing to comply with a lawfully issued subpoena
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a lawful order of the board or department previously entered in a disciplinary hearing; or failure to comply with a lawfully issued subpoena of the board or department

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging or attempting to engage in sexual misconduct as defined in the chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging or attempting to engage in sexual misconduct as defined and prohibited in s. 466.027

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering anesthesia in a manner which violates rules of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering anesthesia in a manner which violates rules of the board adopted pursuant to s. 466.017

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to timely and completely comply with adverse incident reporting requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A failure by the dentist or dental hygienist to timely and completely comply with all the reporting requirements in this section is the basis for disciplinary action by the board

definition_quote.value: the healing art which is concerned with the examination, diagnosis, treatment planning, and care of conditions within the human oral cavity and its adjacent tissues and structures. It includes the performance or attempted performance of any dental operation, or oral or oral-maxillofacial surgery and any procedures adjunct thereto
definition_quote.quote: the healing art which is concerned with the examination, diagnosis, treatment planning, and care of conditions within the human oral cavity and its adjacent tissues and structures. It includes the performance or attempted performance of any dental operation, or oral or oral-maxillofacial surgery and any procedures adjunct thereto, including physical evaluation directly related to such operation or surgery pursuant to hospital rules and regulations

methods_authorized.quote: A dentist shall have the right to prescribe drugs or medicine, subject to limitations imposed by law; perform surgical operations within the scope of her or his practice and training; administer general or local anesthesia or sedation, subject to limitations imposed by law; and use such appliances as may be necessary to the proper practice of dentistry

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe drugs and medicine subject to limitations imposed by law, including controlled substances subject to specific requirements
drug_authority.quote: A dentist shall have the right to prescribe drugs or medicine, subject to limitations imposed by law

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: administer general or local anesthesia or sedation, subject to limitations imposed by law

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: Establish further requirements relating to the use of general anesthesia or sedation, including, but not limited to, office equipment and the training of dental assistants or dental hygienists who work with dentists using general anesthesia or sedation

sedation_adverse_event_reporting_require.quote: Any adverse incident that occurs in an office maintained by a dentist must be reported to the department. The required notification to the department must be submitted in writing by certified mail and postmarked within 48 hours after the incident occurs

specialist_license_available.quote: A dentist licensed under this chapter may not hold himself or herself out as a specialist, or advertise membership in or specialty recognition by an accrediting organization, unless the dentist: (a) Has completed a specialty education program approved by the American Dental Association and the Commission on Dental Accreditation

specialty_advertising_disclaimer_require.quote: a dentist who lacks membership in or certification, diplomate status, or other similar credentials from an accrediting organization approved as bona fide by either the American Dental Association or the board may announce a practice emphasis in any other area of dental practice if the dentist incorporates in capital letters or some other manner clearly distinguishable from the rest of the announcement, solicitation, or advertisement the following statement

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: Direct supervision means supervision whereby a dentist diagnoses the condition to be treated, a dentist authorizes the procedure to be performed, a dentist remains on the premises while the procedures are performed, and a dentist approves the work performed before dismissal of the patient. Indirect supervision means supervision whereby a dentist authorizes the procedure and a dentist is on the premises while the procedures are performed. General supervision means supervision whereby a dentist authorizes the procedures which are being carried out but need not be present when the authorized procedures are being performed

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: A dental hygienist licensed in this state may perform the following remediable tasks in a health access setting as defined in s. 466.003 without the physical presence, prior examination, or authorization of a dentist

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: A dental hygienist licensed in this state may perform the following remediable tasks in a health access setting as defined in s. 466.003 without the physical presence, prior examination, or authorization of a dentist

advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: A dental hygienist licensed in this state may perform the following remediable tasks in a health access setting as defined in s. 466.003 without the physical presence, prior examination, or authorization of a dentist

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: No person other than a dentist licensed pursuant to this chapter, nor any entity other than a professional corporation or limited liability company composed of dentists, may: (a) Employ a dentist or dental hygienist in the operation of a dental office

opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: For the treatment of acute pain, a prescription for an opioid drug listed as a Schedule II controlled substance in s. 893.03 or 21 U.S.C. s. 812 may not exceed a 3-day supply, except that up to a 7-day supply may be prescribed if

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: The Department of Health shall establish a practitioner profile for dentists licensed under this chapter for a practitioner's designation as a controlled substance prescribing practitioner

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Each licensed dentist who uses the services of any dental laboratory for the purpose of constructing, altering, repairing, or duplicating any denture, implant, veneer, partial denture, bridge splint, orthodontic or other prosthetic appliance, or other suitable form of artificial oral restorative device shall be required to furnish the dental laboratory with a written prescription

teledentistry_authorized.quote: Telehealth means the use of synchronous or asynchronous telecommunications technology by a telehealth provider to provide health care services, including, but not limited to, assessment, diagnosis, consultation, treatment, and monitoring of a patient

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: A dental hygienist under the direct supervision of a dentist may administer local anesthesia, including intraoral block anesthesia, soft tissue infiltration anesthesia, or both, to a nonsedated patient who is 18 years of age or older, if the following criteria are met: (a) The dental hygienist has successfully completed a course in the administration of local anesthesia

patient_record_retention_years.quote: All patient records kept in accordance with this section shall be maintained for a period of 4 years from the date of the patient's last appointment

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: A dentist or dental hygienist who administers or employs the use of any form of anesthesia must possess a certification in either basic cardiopulmonary resuscitation for health professionals or advanced cardiac life support approved by the American Heart Association or the American Red Cross or an equivalent agency-sponsored course with recertification every 2 years
